source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 自动驾驶违法 车企担责
topics.official_english: Automakers to bear liability when autonomous driving violates traffic rules
topics.why_hot: A policy clarification that would make car companies legally responsible for autonomous-driving violations is drawing wide attention as self-driving technology expands.
topics.share_angle: Explain what the new liability rule means for automakers, drivers, and the future of autonomous driving in China.

topics.chinese_topic: .86秒！人形机器人百米再破纪录
topics.official_english: Humanoid robot breaks its own 100-meter sprint record again
topics.why_hot: A humanoid robot has reportedly set a new 100-meter record, sparking excitement about embodied AI and robotics progress.
topics.share_angle: Frame the record as a sign of fast-improving humanoid robotics and explain why precision and balance make sprinting hard for robots.

topics.why_hot: Durian prices have reportedly fallen sharply, giving consumers a chance to buy the once-expensive fruit at much lower cost.
topics.share_angle: Use the durian price drop to talk about supply chains, import trends, and how the fruit became a mainstream consumer favorite in China.

topics.chinese_topic: 第一个1000公里地铁城市要来了
topics.official_english: China's first city with 1,000 km of metro lines is coming
topics.why_hot: A Chinese city is close to becoming the country's first with 1,000 km of metro rail, a milestone in urban public transport.
topics.share_angle: Explain the significance of a 1,000-km metro network and what it says about urban growth and infrastructure investment.

topics.chinese_topic: 官方：征集火箭军部队违规采购问题
topics.official_english: Officials call for tip-offs on Rocket Force procurement irregularities
topics.why_hot: The announcement invites reports of irregularities in Rocket Force procurement, focusing public attention on military discipline and accountability.
topics.share_angle: Explain the context of military procurement oversight and why the announcement is being discussed.

topics.chinese_topic: 多国宣布：准备向乌克兰派兵
topics.official_english: Multiple countries announce readiness to send troops to Ukraine
topics.why_hot: Several countries have reportedly said they are prepared to send troops to Ukraine, a major geopolitical development that is trending online.
topics.share_angle: Summarize the reported statements and contextualize the possible shift in international support for Ukraine.

topics.chinese_topic: 新生购票和携带物品指南来了
topics.official_english: Guide for new students on ticket buying and permitted items released
topics.why_hot: As the new semester begins, a practical guide on tickets and allowed luggage for newly enrolled students is resonating with families.
topics.share_angle: Turn it into a helpful explainer for students studying in China, covering what to prepare before traveling to campus.

topics.chinese_topic: 武汉轮椅老人上高架蓄意碰瓷不实
topics.official_english: Claim that wheelchair user staged crash on Wuhan elevated road is false
topics.why_hot: Authorities have disputed a viral video that appeared to show a wheelchair user deliberately causing a crash on an elevated road, prompting online calls for caution before sharing clips.
topics.share_angle: Use it as a media-literacy case: how viral videos can mislead and why official verification matters.
